issue.title: Trusted machine artifact-link outbox entries never drain: 8.5k always-eligible derived edge-puts queued since 2026-09-09
issue.description:
Trusted machine artifact-link outbox entries keep accumulating in the project
outbox even though they are always drain-eligible, so the outbox only grows.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1h8.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3, 2026-10-06), routed
here by the sase-1h8 land agent. sase-1h8.2 removed the per-append full-outbox scan,
so a large outbox no longer costs ~2.9 s per audited read, but the backlog itself was
out of that phase's scope ("do not change drain eligibility, release-evidence rules or
retention").

Evidence:
- 2026-10-06 (sase-1h8.2 note #1): gh_sase-org__sase outbox held 11,446 lines / 7.8 MB:
  6,985 edge-put entries from `sase.artifact-link-derived` (trusted machine events,
  always eligible), 186 alias entries from `sase.artifact-link-renames` (trusted), and
  4,275 observation entries from 998 agents (need per-run release evidence). No
  `artifact-link-outbox-dropped.jsonl` existed, so stale-terminal drops never fired.
- 2026-10-09 (sase-1h8 land agent, read-only count of
  `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifact-link-outbox.jsonl`): 13,496 lines /
  9.2 MB, of which 8,545 are `sase.artifact-link-derived` entries. The oldest queued
  entries date from 2026-09-09.
- sase-1h8.2's reading: the drain paths do run (commit workflow, derivation
  self-drain, the artifact-link backfill chop), so the backlog looks publish-side
  (machine writability or push), not a drain path that never runs.

Root cause is not yet known. Find why eligible trusted machine entries are not removed
after publication (or are never published), fix that path, and confirm that the
derived edge-put/alias backlog drains on athena.

task_type_fields.impact:
The outbox grows without bound (7.8 MB to 9.2 MB in three days), and derived artifact
links that are eligible to publish may never reach the shared link store. Every drain
pass also re-reads a larger file.
task_type_fields.location: ~/.sase/projects/<project>/artifact-link-outbox.jsonl; artifact-link outbox drain/publication (src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_outbox_io.py, commit workflow drain, scripts/sase_chop_artifact_link_backfill.py)
task_type_fields.repro:
python3 -c "import json,collections; c=collections.Counter(json.loads(l).get('agent_name') for l in open('$HOME/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifact-link-outbox.jsonl')); print(c.most_common(3))"
# 2026-10-09: sase.artifact-link-derived = 8,545 of 13,496 lines (6,985 of 11,446 on 2026-10-06)

issue.creation_reason: sase-1h8.2 proposed it (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3): its scope forbade changing drain/retention, and the sase-1h8 land agent confirmed on 2026-10-09 that the backlog is still growing.
